# Standard compatibility assembly (#306)

## Scope and ownership

The assembly consumes the existing MATLAB-authoritative forcing, variable and forward-integration catalogs, adds explicit observer, sampling, output/persistence and execution axes, and generates the public compatibility document from the same records used by validation. Original slice rows and historical execution receipts remain authoritative in their own scope. A fixture declaration is not a new numerical execution result.

The audit found MATLAB-supported gridded interpolation beyond the portable sampling mask. Those records must remain unqualified with tracked follow-up work, rather than being described as MATLAB-inapplicable or excluded from standard parity. Missing mapped exact-pair evidence is distinguished from a known implementation gap. #307 owns the final decision and current execution evidence.

## Verification ledger

The old JSON schema only enumerated two transform classes despite later source slices; the schema is corrected and extended for standard assembly.

The isolated repair changed only the current digest and retained its five passing focused methods in #447. Assembly work includes that repaired prerequisite without modifying numerical source.

Root review strengthened the initially surface-only points to three interior depths; final results are separately retained. The three prior stratified-family sampling methods also pass reference-only; their legacy native harness lacked a native provider, so no legacy-native result is claimed.

The release-export helper has zero findings. No stable code was refactored to suppress baseline findings.

All 51 CI policy tests pass after installing the existing pinned YAML dependency in an isolated temporary environment. An earlier run without that dependency and during a sampling-source edit correctly failed; final provenance is checked again after the last source-bound generation.

Forty additional MATLAB-supported moving cases remain unqualified under #454, alongside 526 absent diagnostic sampling modes. Final matrix: 1,794 rows, 74 witnesses, 1,206 supported fixture assignments, 22 intentional incompatibilities, 566 unqualified cases.
